perceptual_method: ImageHash 64-bit dHash; all image pairs Hamming <=4; uncalibrated screening only. Full-path pair list losslessly represented by hash buckets and bucket edges. Distinct buckets expand Cartesian product; same bucket expands unordered distinct path pairs. High collision rate suggests poor discrimination; do not equate with identity.
